## Checklist

- [ ] The issue is assigned to me / Issue đã được assign cho tôi
- [ ] PR is ~400 changed lines or less (excluding lockfiles/fixtures/generated)
- [ ] No new dependencies / Không thêm dependency
- [ ] No changes to signing, keys, wallets, CI or secrets / Không chạm ký tx, khoá, ví, CI, secret
- [ ] Uses Hydra **v2** APIs only (no `Commit` phase, `HeadIsInitializing`, `Abort`, …)
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, build and tests pass locally
- [ ] Docs EN/VI/JA kept in sync (if docs changed)
- [ ] I have signed the CLA / Tôi đã ký CLA
